changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla pilots: configuración del piloto sobre una ruta (fechas, semilla de aleatorización y estado). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría pilots_audit y el trigger pilots_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Pilot study configuration of a learning path (randomization and measurement dates)

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: random_seed
column.remarks: Seed used to randomize the learners into arms

column.name: status
column.remarks: Pilot status: draft, randomized, running or closed

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE pilots ADD CONSTRAINT pilots_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'randomized', 'running', 'closed'))
ALTER TABLE pilots ADD CONSTRAINT pilots_dates_ck CHECK (ends_on >= starts_on)
CREATE TRIGGER pilots_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON pilots FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in pilots

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE pilots_audit ADD CONSTRAINT pilots_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER pilots_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON pilots FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS pilots_audit_trg ON pilots
